notes: Class A trades on the NYSE as NU (direct listing of the ordinary shares, not ADRs; Brazilian BDRs are not used). Class B (20 votes per share) is unlisted and priced through Class A. Counts are shares authorized and fully issued at September 30, 2026 from Nu's Q3 2026 interim statements (filed on Form 6-K), which deduct the 40,659,600 Class A shares repurchased in 2026; they are newer than the 20-F cover count (3,833,072,934 Class A and 1,022,600,698 Class B at December 31, 2025).
